name: lash.fork
doc: Cut a Kiln fork of lash at freshly fetched origin/main (`kiln fork lash <name>`, a git worktree on a detached HEAD). Returns its path and head. One fork per worker; remove it with lash.fork_rm. With base, the fork is then moved onto that commit (a local, unmerged commit of another fork, for stacking); the worker rebases onto origin/main once the base lands. With review true the fork is cut with `kiln fork --no-build` (env.sh inert): no Bazel server, no pool use; use it for read-only studies.
